items.title: Lee Paige Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: Yes, I appeared with Clyde McCoy in quite a number of places. Some of them were in ballrooms and some of them were in nightclubs, supper clubs.

ctx.x: Lee, at one time or other, didn't you have Clyde McCoy play with you?
Yes, I appeared with Clyde McCoy in quite a number of places. Some of them were in ballrooms and some of them were in nightclubs, supper clubs.
Lee, didn't you also work in some walkathons in Chicago?
